stages.reading: The agent reads what it was given and what is connected. The feed in the chat shows one tool call per line; each line reveals plan rows (Read.rv keys). The composer is off ('Reading…'). Ends with 'draft the plan' and the steps appear.
stages.questions: Only what the reads could not find, one card at a time (kind 'q'). A card folds to one line when answered: by tile, by text, by Edit on the plan row, or by a document from a connector that answers it.
stages.plan: No open question. Status pill 'Ready to agree' / 'Ready to arm'. Chips offer the main changes; free text that matches no chip is added to 'What I'm taking as given'. Changes that touch a step show a diff card first (Apply / Leave it). Every change bumps the version and lands in Changes and the Log. Footer button: 'Agree and run' or 'Arm the watch'.
stages.running: (once) The plan is agreed. Steps run on the run script; each completion writes an event line; findings land as steps finish, provisional until 'ready'. A checkpoint stops the run ('wait'): for the rate base, how the nine completed projects in CWIP are treated. Pause and resume; steer (diff, stale, re-run); fork (one at a time). Then 'ready', accept findings, choose ('accepted'): the goal moves to Executed; outputs are built in Submissions.
stages.armed: (watch) The plan is armed (armedAt, armedBy, nextCheck). Nothing runs until the rule fires or the schedule is due ('Simulate tonight’s order load (20 October)' or 'Simulate: run now' in the demo). On firing: a notification (toast and bell) says it fired; status 'fired' while the five steps run by themselves; 'ready' when the note is sent, with a second notification carrying what it found and what it recommends. The run waits under Needs you. Choose shows an execute card ('confirm'); nothing happens until Execute ('executing', then 'executed'); a third notification; the run moves to Executed and the watch stays armed.
